Mark your calendars mi gente, Alicia is pulling up ALL the way from Seattle and we are not playing about this one 💃🔥 Sholeh and Bachata Connection are already turning up the heat, but now we've got a special guest instructor crossing state lines just to be on our floor. That's the kind of lineup that makes you clear your Thursday real quick. Class first, breaking down the footwork step by step, then the floor opens up for social dancing until you're dripping sweat under that neon glow. No partner? No problem — todos caben en esta pista, solo, con pareja, o con tu crew entera. This is a once-in-a-while kind of night, the lineup alone tells you it's not getting repeated anytime soon. Get here early, get on that floor, and let Alicia and Sholeh show you why Bachata Connection nights hit different 🌟

Neon glow, slow bachata beats, dos maestras on the floor ✨🌙 Picture it: Sholeh breaking down the steps while Alicia — visiting all the way from Seattle — adds her own flavor to every move. The lights dim, the bassline creeps in, and before you know it your hips are already moving without permission. Class first, step by step, nice and easy. Then the Main space flips into a full social — bodies swaying, hands finding hands, risas floating over the music. It's intimate, it's a little sweaty, it's the kind of night where the music gets under your skin y no quieres parar. Two instructors, one floor, pure sabor. Bring your energy, leave your inhibitions at the door, and let the rhythm do the rest 💫

Zero rhythm? Two left feet? Never danced bachata in your life? Girl, same energy here and we still show up every time 😂💃 This is the floor where nobody's judging your footwork, we're all just trying to figure out where our hips are supposed to go. Sholeh's teaching, special guest Alicia's in the building straight from Seattle, and the whole point is just to have fun learning together. Come solo and leave with new dance partners, come with your crew and get silly together, come as you are porque aquí todos caben. The class is the easy part — the real magic happens after when the floor opens up and everybody's just vibing, mistakes and all. No pressure, no perfect steps required, just good music and better company 🫶

Okay let's keep this simple porque you need these details 📝 Bachata class with Sholeh and Bachata Connection, plus special guest instructor Alicia coming in from Seattle, happening this Thursday. Class runs 8-9PM, then the floor stays open for social dancing right after — no cutoff, just keep moving as long as you want. $5 at the door, that's it, that's the whole investment for a full night of footwork and good music. No partner needed, no experience needed, just show up ready to learn and have fun. Bring a friend, bring your whole group chat, or come solo and make new dance partners on the floor. This is the easiest plan you'll make all week — low cost, high payoff, guaranteed good time 🔥
